messages.recipient_title: Vice President & Head of Sustainability - SCO, Central Asia, Levant & Egypt
messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | DP World | Sustainability & Stakeholder Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Sharma,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for DP World, focused on sustainable logistics, port electrification, emissions assurance, stakeholder partnerships and cross-border infrastructure execution. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief outlines areas where this experience could support sustainability delivery and institutional alignment across complex markets. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic mandates where my background would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for DP World
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Vice President & Head of Sustainability - SCO, Central Asia, Levant & Egypt
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers a leadership profile aligned with DP World's agenda across sustainable logistics, port electrification, emissions assurance, strategic partnerships and cross-border infrastructure delivery. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security, aviation and technical teams, translating external commitments into coordinated execution. For DP World, his strongest contribution would sit where sustainability ambitions, government relationships, local stakeholder expectations and capital-intensive operating programmes require common governance, evidence and executive accountability across markets.
strategic_brief.company_context: DP World continues to expand an integrated global trade and logistics platform while investing in port capacity, operational efficiency and lower-carbon infrastructure. Public 2026 disclosures point to major capital programmes, renewable power, shore-power deployment and independently verified emissions reporting. These priorities require close coordination between sustainability teams, operations, engineering, regulators, local authorities, customers and communities. Regional execution also depends on consistent engagement with governments and strong evidence of economic and environmental value. Leadership that links ESG governance with institutional relationships and practical operating delivery can strengthen confidence, accelerate issue resolution and help scale successful sustainability programmes across diverse markets.

opportunities.title: Sustainable infrastructure governance
opportunities.rationale: Port electrification, renewable energy and efficiency projects require coordinated ownership across engineering, operations, finance, regulators and sustainability teams. Clear governance improves decision speed and evidence quality across project lifecycles.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can establish cross-functional governance, commitment registers and executive dashboards linking sustainability objectives to project milestones, operating owners, regulatory interfaces and assurance evidence.

opportunities.title: Government and stakeholder alignment
opportunities.rationale: Trade infrastructure depends on trusted relationships with governments, port authorities, communities and customers. Early engagement reduces friction and keeps local expectations aligned with investment and operational priorities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can structure stakeholder maps, engagement calendars, escalation pathways and institutional narratives that connect public-sector priorities with measurable operational and economic outcomes.

opportunities.title: Assurance-ready climate evidence
opportunities.rationale: Emissions performance and environmental claims carry greater value when methodologies, data ownership and independent verification are embedded into management processes rather than added after project completion.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can help build evidence registers, source ownership and review gates that make sustainability reporting more traceable, consistent and defensible across multiple operating locations.

days_0_30: Map priority sustainability projects, government interfaces and evidence owners.
days_31_60: Build stakeholder, commitment and assurance registers for selected markets.
days_61_90: Launch cross-functional governance for priority infrastructure and climate workstreams.
days_91_180: Scale metrics, assurance checks and executive reporting across regional operations.

potential_impact: Stronger sustainability governance across capital projects.
More credible and traceable emissions evidence.
Improved government and community alignment around infrastructure investments.
background_relevance: Government and regulatory relations across multiple public authorities.
ESG, strategic partnerships and social-performance leadership in a capital-intensive sector.
Cross-functional coordination with operations, legal, finance, procurement, security and technical teams.
